meta.name: fine-tuning-with-trl
meta.description: Fine-tune LLMs using reinforcement learning with TRL - SFT for instruction tuning, DPO for preference alignment, PPO/GRPO for reward optimization, and reward model training. Use when need RLHF, align model with preferences, or train from human feedback. Works with HuggingFace Transformers.

copy.tagline: 用强化学习微调大语言模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用RLHF或偏好对齐来微调LLM
copy.tagline_en: Fine-tune large language models with reinforcement learning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to fine-tune LLMs using RLHF or preference alignment

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude帮你用强化学习微调大语言模型，包括监督微调、偏好对齐、奖励模型训练和PPO/GRPO强化学习。
howto.when: 当你需要对齐模型与人类偏好、进行RLHF训练，或使用HuggingFace Transformers时触发。

say.note: Claude会生成监督微调的代码。

say.text: 用DPO对齐模型偏好，数据集用ultrafeedback_binarized。
运行完整的RLHF流程：SFT→奖励模型→PPO。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to help you fine-tune large language models using reinforcement learning with TRL, including supervised fine-tuning, preference alignment, reward model training, and PPO/GRPO reinforcement learning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to align a model with human preferences, perform RLHF training, or work with HuggingFace Transformers.

say_en.text: Help me fine-tune Qwen2.5-0.5B with SFT.
Align model preferences using DPO with ultrafeedback_binarized dataset.
say_en.note: Claude will generate DPO training code.

say_en.text: Run full RLHF pipeline: SFT → reward model → PPO.
